baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence مِتْنَا -> كُنَّا تُرَابًا and the predicate رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Loss of life leads to an actual dust-state; rajʿ then proposes restoration to what was, while baʿīd measures the resulting break as beyond reach.

activation_trace.role: Loss of force and life marks the process's initial discontinuity.
Occurrence in time makes dust a state reached after death.
Earth, dust, and soil provide the body's terminal material state.
Return or restoration to what was supplies the proposed reversal.
Distance from nearness makes that reversal something the speakers judge out of reach.

changed_reading.before: A bare yes-or-no question about resurrection.
changed_reading.after: A staged objection: life is lost, the human becomes dust, and restoration must cross a material gap the speakers call unreachable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporally ordered أَءِذَا ... وَكُنَّا construction and بَعِيدٌ modifying رَجْعٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because baʿd can mark what comes after what was before, the adjective can grade delay as well as feasibility; the return lies beyond the speakers' temporal horizon.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in time supplies the ordered state through which the objection moves.
Return to a prior condition supplies the backward relation across that order.
After in contrast with before lets distance register a remote position in sequence.

changed_reading.after: That return is pushed so far beyond death and dust in time that the speakers treat delay as impossibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contact between تُرَابًا and the rain-or-returning-water branch of رَجْعٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dust as ground and rajʿ as recurrent rain or water allow a latent cycle: apparently lifeless substrate can receive a returning input, although the focus alone does not establish the analogy.

activation_trace.role: Lifeless land or material lets human death cast dust as an inert substrate.
Soil provides the medium in which recurrence could become materially visible.
Returning rain or water supplies a recurrent rather than merely backward motion.

changed_reading.before: Return means only reversal to a former embodiment.
changed_reading.after: Return may also be pictured as recurrence through dust, like water revisiting lifeless ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's action becomes finite subtraction rather than annihilation, while disclosed knowledge, writing, and guarding retain a counter-continuity; return is recovery from tracked dispersion.

activation_trace.role: Dust supplies the apparently identity-erasing material state that the context answers.
Restoration to what was names the operation newly supplied with continuity.
Disclosure to a knower removes dispersion from the category of the unknown.
Loss of only some of a thing models decomposition as determinate diminution.
Written, ordered signs supply a stable register against material dispersal.
Guarding and watchful preservation keep that register from sharing the body's loss.

structural_cues: 50:4 immediately answers the dust objection with what the earth diminishes and a guarding book.
The verse distributes opposing actions: earth removes, while knowledge and record preserve.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies known diminution by earth plus a guarded book; I infer that the register preserves identity-relevant continuity across dispersion. A live alternative is that the book records decree or deeds only, while knowledge alone grounds recovery.

changed_reading.before: Dust is an untracked endpoint from which the same person cannot return.
changed_reading.after: Dust is tracked loss: the earth subtracts from a person whose continuity remains known and guarded, making return retrieval rather than recovery from nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water enters soil, induced growth comes out, a dead terrain receives life, and the final earth splits away from persons; the whole sequence activates rajʿ as recurrent input followed by emergence.

activation_trace.role: Soil is the shared substrate joining human dust to the growth sequence.
Returning rain or water supplies the cycle that context turns from latent to visible.
Water supplies the mobile material input into apparently inert ground.
Caused planting and growth convert the water input into organized living output.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation explicitly names reactivation of dead terrain.
Passage to the outside turns revival into emergence from a containing medium.
Splitting and opening the earth gives human emergence the same inside-to-outside geometry.

structural_cues: 50:9-11 forms input -> growth -> life -> خروج and closes with 'thus the emergence'.
50:44 completes the surah-wide image by making the earth split away from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water, caused growth, life of dead terrain, خروج, and opened earth; I map the vegetal sequence analogically onto human return. The live alternative is that vegetation demonstrates agency without specifying resurrection's material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The rain-water branch of rajʿ is an isolated lexical curiosity beside human dust.
changed_reading.after: Return is rendered as a witnessed cycle: life-bearing input reaches earth, organized life emerges, and human dust finally exits through opened ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first/new creation pair permits the person to return through fresh bringing-into-being, while denied incapacity, denied fatigue, and easy gathering relocate difficulty from the act to the skeptics' model of it.

activation_trace.role: Dust supplies the broken material continuity that fresh creation must answer.
Return to what was anchors personal continuity even if embodiment is newly effected.
Remoteness supplies the skeptics' implicit scale of operative difficulty.
Incapacity to find or execute a course is explicitly denied as a limit on creation.
Creative bringing-into-being supplies the productive act for both first and new creation.
Novel occurrence after severance lets renewed embodiment follow material discontinuity.
Weakness and fatigue are negated, removing energetic strain from the model.
Openness and ease after difficulty characterize the gathering that completes return.

structural_cues: 50:15 directly opposes first creation to new creation rather than saying only that old dust is reversed.
50:38 denies fatigue and 50:44 calls the gathering easy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies first and new creation plus absence of incapacity, fatigue, and difficulty; I infer that returned identity can persist through newly effected embodiment. A live alternative is exact recreation of prior matter rather than materially fresh embodiment.

changed_reading.before: Return must reverse the same dust into the same former matter and is therefore operationally remote.
changed_reading.after: The person can return through effortless new creation: rajʿ carries identity and destination, while the embodiment that realizes it may be newly brought into being.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine presence is near, the garden is driven into proximity, and the final caller speaks from a near place; baʿīd becomes an index of the skeptics' viewpoint rather than an invariant property of return.

activation_trace.role: Distance from nearness supplies the judgment whose viewpoint context contests.
Nearness contrary to distance places the knowing creator closer than the objector assumes.
Movement into proximity makes the promised destination approach rather than remain remote.
A near place locates the initiating summons on the opposite side of the focus adjective.

structural_cues: 50:31 describes the approached garden as 'not far'.
50:41 places the resurrection summons at a near place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several explicit proximity statements against the focus claim of distance; I assign the contrast to differing human and divine or event-side viewpoints. A live alternative is that each near statement has a distinct referent and only rebuts, rather than redefines, the focus adjective.

changed_reading.before: The return has an objectively large distance from present reality.
changed_reading.after: The return is distant only from the skeptics' horizon; from the creator, destination, and summons side, the same event is near and approaching.

context_deltas.mechanism: Swerving, heedlessness, a covering, and the search for escape turn 'far' into an affective operation: the demonstrative-adjective construction pushes an unwelcome return away from present awareness.

activation_trace.role: Distance supplies the semantic material for an act of psychological pushing-away.
Turning aside from a path identifies avoidance as the relation to death.
Heedless omission keeps the approaching event outside active awareness.
Removal of a cover reverses the prior cognitive distancing.
A covering of ignorance supplies the barrier that made the event seem remote.
Deviation in search of escape exposes remoteness as a failed evasive strategy.

structural_cues: 50:19 calls death what the addressee kept swerving from.
50:22 moves from heedlessness to cover removal, and 50:36 asks whether any escape exists.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies avoidance, heedlessness, covering, uncovering, and failed escape; I infer that calling the return far performs the same avoidance in speech. A live alternative is that these cues diagnose disbelief generally without making baʿīd itself a speech act.

changed_reading.after: 'Far' is also defensive rhetoric: the speakers verbally distance the death and return from which the surah says they swerve and cannot escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: A driver imposes motion, a witness accompanies the same accountable self, the movement has a stated destination, and rapid gathering collects the dispersed; rajʿ becomes directed arrival for judgment, not mere biological restarting.

activation_trace.role: Return to an originating direction supplies the movement that context vectorizes.
Driving and herding make the returning self's movement compelled and directional.
Presence with witnessing preserves the juridical identity of the one being driven.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the return's explicit endpoint.
Speed contrary to slowness collapses the delay implied by the skeptics' remoteness.
Driving and collecting a group toward one goal converts dispersed returns into one gathering.

structural_cues: 50:21 gives every self a driver and witness.
50:43 names the destination as 'to Us', and 50:44 names rapid gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escort, witness, destination, speed, and collective gathering; I bundle them as functional specifications of the focus rajʿ. A live alternative is that these are stages after resurrection rather than semantic content carried by rajʿ itself.

changed_reading.before: Return means only that a dead body lives again.
changed_reading.after: Return is an accountable transit: the same self is driven with a witness toward its destination and collected rapidly with others.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because bodily dust strongly governs rajʿ here, but the focus root's return-of-answer branch and 50:18's monitored outward utterance keep it anchored. Render only as a secondary speech resonance, never as a replacement for bodily resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَجْعٌ in 50:3 through the branch of a returned answer or speech.

activation_trace.role: Returning an answer or utterance allows the skeptical statement itself to enter a return circuit.
Casting something from the mouth gives speech an outward trajectory that can be answered or returned.
Spoken production identifies the focus objection as an accountable emitted saying.
Monitoring and waiting prevent the emitted objection from disappearing after speech.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely label bodily return far-fetched.
changed_reading.after: Their label is itself a cast-out, monitored utterance that the surah returns with an answer and preserves for judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The repeated-line or tattoo branch of rajʿ is materially distant from resurrection, but it remains anchored to the focus noun and is activated by earthly diminution plus guarded writing. Render as an analogy of pattern restoration, not as a claim that the body literally is text.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَجْعٌ in 50:3 through the branch of renewed lines, markings, or inscription after fading.

activation_trace.role: Dust supplies the erasure-like dispersal of the former embodied pattern.
Renewed lines and darkened markings supply a concrete image of restoring a vanished pattern.
Partial loss models fading or removal without requiring loss of the recoverable whole.
Ordered written signs provide the preserved pattern from which retracing can proceed.
Guarding keeps the inscribed pattern intact while its material manifestation is lost.

changed_reading.before: Return restores a vanished body by unspecified reversal.
changed_reading.after: Return can be pictured as retracing a guarded identity-pattern after its material marks have faded into dust.

strongest_changes: Earthly decomposition became known diminution paired with a guarded register, not untracked annihilation.
Rain, growth, revived land, emergence, and opened earth activated a visible recurrence-through-soil model.
First and new creation plus denied fatigue and easy gathering separated returned identity from uninterrupted old matter.
Nearness, avoidance, and unveiling recast 'far' as a human viewpoint and defensive act rather than an objective measure.
Driver, witness, destination, speed, and gathering turned return into accountable arrival.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package let early preservation and growth cues combine with late nearness, summons, earth-splitting, and gathering while keeping their mechanisms distinct rather than forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The guarded book may preserve identity-relevant information, decree, deeds, or some combination.
The vegetation sequence may specify a material analogy or only demonstrate creative power.
The relation between prior identity and new creation remains underdetermined: same matter, restored form, or continuity secured by knowledge.
The returned-utterance and reinscribed-pattern readings remain branch-distant resonances requiring explicit qualification.
